concept: Tauri desktop gold (XAUUSD) trading terminal blending Swiss technical precision, Bloomberg/institutional data density, and military radar ergonomics.
target_audience: Algorithmic gold traders, quantitative prop traders, automated layer execution specialists

typography.mono_numeric_font: JetBrains Mono, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

layout_architecture.viewport: h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden flex flex-col bg-[#07090E] text-gray-100 select-none

top_status_bar.style: bg-[#0C1017] border-b border-[#1F2937] px-4 flex items-center justify-between z-40
components: Brand identity (MIB-GOLD v2.4 + MT5 Bridge indicator)
Current Risk Used Gauge bar (4.2% / 10.0% max limit)
Active Layers count pill (3 layers / 1.80 lots)
Spread / Session timer pill (NY Overlap / 0.12 pip spread)
Screen switcher tabs (Terminal, Trade Journal, Backtest Lab)

news_gate_banner.condition: Active when high impact USD/FOMC/CPI event is within blocked window (<45m)
news_gate_banner.style: bg-red-950/40 border-y border-red-500/40 px-4 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-red-300
elements: High impact event ticker with flashing radar pulse
Countdown timer to release window: 'US Non-Farm Payrolls in 00:24:18'
Execution lock status: 'NEWS GATE ACTIVE: All new market orders blocked | Protective SL trailed to +1.2R'

main_dashboard_layout.left_zone_chart: flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 border-r border-[#1F2937] bg-[#07090E]
main_dashboard_layout.chart_toolbar: h-10 bg-[#0C1017] border-b border-[#1F2937] px-3 flex items-center justify-between
main_dashboard_layout.chart_view: Realtime Canvas/SVG Candlestick engine with Volume Profile, Layer Entry markers (L1, L2, L3), Trailing TP/SL dynamic ray overlays, ATR bands, and Order Blocks
main_dashboard_layout.bottom_layers_panel: h-56 bg-[#0C1017] border-t border-[#1F2937] flex flex-col overflow-hidden
main_dashboard_layout.right_zone_agent_board: w-96 flex flex-col bg-[#0C1017] border-l border-[#1F2937] overflow-y-auto

table_columns: Status & Actions (Lock Break-even, Close Layer, Re-weight)

trade_journal_screen_spec.title: AUDIT JOURNAL & 10-ENGINE JUSTIFICATION CARDS
features: Filterable by Engine vote leader, Direction (Long/Short), Session (London/NY/Asia), Outcome (Win/Loss/BE)
Summary stats: Win Rate 71.4%, Profit Factor 2.84, Avg R 2.18R, Total Closed Gain +$48,920.00

Interactive Expandable Trade Cards: When clicked, expands into full 10-agent vote breakdown matrix, entry trigger chart snapshot, execution latency, slippage, and plain-English post-mortem justification
Export capability (CSV, JSON, MT5 statement sync)

features: Time scrubber slider with play/pause/step-frame speed controls (1x, 5x, 20x, 100x)
Interactive Equity Curve with Drawdown underwater chart (Recharts dual area/line)
Per-Engine Performance Attribution Matrix: Win rate contribution, Sharpe contribution, Alpha generation per engine
Historical bar-by-bar Agent Consensus replay (showing exactly how all 10 engines voted at each historical candle)
Monte Carlo simulation stress-test widget for maximum layer drawdown estimation

visual_enhancers.grid_borders: 1px solid #1F2937 terminal borders with subtle glowing active headers
visual_enhancers.tactical_badges: Square sharp badges with mono text, 1px borders, and colored status pips
visual_enhancers.candlestick_engine: High frame rate SVG/HTML5 interactive chart with crosshair coordinates, bid/ask spread line, and layer entry markers
visual_enhancers.audio_visual_cues: Subtle flashing border indicator when News Gate turns red or when consensus reaches >90%
visual_enhancers.zero_fluff: No generic rounded pastel cards. Pure tactical command-center obsidian interface with high APCA contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the full 3-screen desktop trading application: 1) Live Terminal (Default), 2) Trade Journal / Audit, 3) Backtest & Attribution Lab.
Build a rich simulated real-time data engine with live tick updates, candlestick generation, dynamic floating P&L calculations, and interactive order layer management.

Ensure all 10 AI trading engines are fully rendered with confidence progress bars, color-coded directional bias (Green for Bullish, Red for Bearish, Cyan/Amber for Protect/Scale), and specific analytical reasoning.
Implement the high-impact News Gate persistent banner with active countdown and live safety state toggle.
Create the Active Layers panel showing individual pyramided positions with dual R-multiple and explicit plain-English floating dollar values (e.g., '+$696.00 (+2.97%) | +2.48 R').
Ensure seamless tab switching between Terminal, Journal, and Backtest screens while preserving live execution states.
Include simulated controls for manual layer execution, risk preset adjusters, and simulation / MT5 bridge toggle.
Strictly follow the Dark Obsidian Tactical Terminal visual style: sharp corners, high APCA contrast, monospaced numeric values, and 1px hairline structural grid borders.
